lines.zh: 蹄子踩在落叶上，声音很轻。
lines.en: My hooves barely rustle the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 樱花落在鹿角上，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Cherry petals settle on my antlers; I shake them off.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间的小径慢慢走。
lines.en: I follow the little path winding through the trees.

lines.zh: 前面有片嫩草，脚步快了些。
lines.en: Fresh grass ahead — my steps quicken a little.

lines.zh: 树枝擦过侧腹，我侧身让开。
lines.en: A branch grazes my flank; I step around it.

lines.zh: 四只蹄子陷进松软的苔藓里。
lines.en: All four hooves sink into the soft moss.

lines.zh: 我跳过倒木，鹿角差点挂住。
lines.en: I leap the fallen log; my antlers nearly snag.

lines.zh: 幼鹿跟在后面，我放慢步子。
lines.en: A fawn trails behind, so I slow my pace.

lines.zh: 溪水边泥软，我挑干的地方落脚。
lines.en: The creek bank is soft; I pick the dry ground.

lines.zh: 影子在前面拉长，太阳偏西了。
lines.en: My shadow stretches ahead; the sun is sinking.

lines.zh: 我绕着樱花树走，花瓣铺了一路。
lines.en: I circle the cherry tree, petals paving my way.

lines.zh: 耳朵转来转去，脚却没停。
lines.en: My ears keep turning while my feet keep moving.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，只让耳朵转。
lines.en: I stand still and let only my ears turn.

lines.zh: 风里有橡树和湿土的味道。
lines.en: The wind smells of oak bark and wet earth.

lines.zh: 鹿角上还挂着半片樱花。
lines.en: Half a cherry blossom still clings to my antler.

lines.zh: 我低头啃了一口脚边的草。
lines.en: I lower my head and nibble the grass by my hooves.

lines.zh: 远处有狼嚎，我绷紧了腿。
lines.en: A wolf howls far off; my legs go tense.

lines.zh: 斑驳的光落在背上，暖洋洋的。
lines.en: Dappled light warms my back through the canopy.

lines.zh: 我用后蹄挠了挠耳朵后面。
lines.en: I scratch behind my ear with a hind hoof.

lines.zh: 树影移动，我跟着挪了半步。
lines.en: The shade shifts; I shuffle half a step over.

lines.zh: 呼吸很慢，肚子一起一伏。
lines.en: My breathing is slow, my flank rising and falling.

lines.zh: 我盯着那片晃动的蕨叶看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at that swaying fern for a long while.

lines.zh: 有只兔子经过，我们互相看了看。
lines.en: A rabbit passes; we look at each other.

lines.zh: 雨点落在鼻尖，我甩了甩头。
lines.en: A raindrop lands on my nose; I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，听林子里别的声音。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward another sound in the woods.

lines.zh: 这一小片林间空地，我常来。
lines.en: This little clearing is a place I often visit.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条前腿，挠了挠脖子。
lines.en: I lift a foreleg and scratch my neck.

lines.zh: 林子里有啄木鸟，一下一下的。
lines.en: A woodpecker is knocking somewhere, over and over.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草，眼睛还看着远处。
lines.en: I chew the grass while still watching the distance.

lines.zh: 雪松的香气从坡上传下来。
lines.en: The scent of cedar drifts down from the slope.

lines.zh: 你站住，我也站住。
lines.en: You stop; so do I.

lines.zh: 你的气味我还不认识。
lines.en: I don't know your scent yet.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鹿角对着你。
lines.en: I raise my head, antlers pointed your way.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我随时能跑。
lines.en: Don't come closer; I can bolt any moment.

lines.zh: 你的手空着，这让我放心一点。
lines.en: Your hands are empty, which settles me somewhat.

lines.zh: 我从樱树后面探出半个头。
lines.en: I peek half my head from behind the cherry tree.

lines.zh: 你看我，我就多看了你两眼。
lines.en: You watch me, so I watch you two beats longer.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声太直，绕一绕吧。
lines.en: You walk too straight; try going around.

lines.zh: 我眨了一下眼，没打算走。
lines.en: I blink once and decide not to leave.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁的味道，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of iron, and I don't care for it.

lines.zh: 那只幼鹿在我身后，别吓它。
lines.en: The fawn's behind me; please don't frighten it.

lines.zh: 我们隔着三棵树互相打量。
lines.en: Three trees apart, we size each other up.

lines.zh: 我的腿一软，差点跪下。
lines.en: My legs buckle; I nearly go down.

lines.zh: 鹿角被撞得偏向一边。
lines.en: My antler's knocked to one side.

lines.zh: 我喘得很急，喉头发紧。
lines.en: I'm breathing hard, throat tight.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我肩胛上。
lines.en: That one caught me on the shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿往树后躲。
lines.en: I drag one leg behind a tree.

lines.zh: 毛被扯掉一小撮。
lines.en: A tuft of my coat's been torn loose.

lines.zh: 我疼得跳了一下，落地歪了。
lines.en: I leap from the pain and land crooked.

lines.zh: 别打在角上，那里最疼。
lines.en: Not the antlers — that's where it hurts most.

lines.zh: 我要跑了，这回是真的。
lines.en: I'm running now — I mean it.

lines.zh: 血滴在落叶上，颜色很深。
lines.en: Blood drops on the leaves, dark against them.

lines.zh: 你袖口的嫩草味，我隔着树都闻到了。
lines.en: I smelled the fresh grass on your sleeve through the trees.

lines.zh: 再举高一点，我够不着。
lines.en: Hold it a little higher; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 那几颗甜浆果是给我的吗？
lines.en: Are those sweet berries meant for me?

lines.zh: 我往前走一步，你也别动。
lines.en: I take one step forward; you hold still.

lines.zh: 叶子上的露水还在滴。
lines.en: Dew is still dripping off those leaves.

lines.zh: 我先舔一下，不咬你的手。
lines.en: I'll lick it first, not bite your hand.

lines.zh: 这味道比林边的草甜多了。
lines.en: This tastes sweeter than the grass at the forest edge.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才敢靠近。
lines.en: Crouch down, and then I'll dare come near.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子先碰到你的指尖了。
lines.en: My nose touches your fingertips before my teeth.

lines.zh: 就一口，然后我就回林子里。
lines.en: Just one mouthful, then I'm back to the trees.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞歪了我的鹿角。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked my antlers crooked.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我这身骨头很细。
lines.en: Easy — my bones are thin and light.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，蹄子打了个滑。
lines.en: I back off two steps and my hooves slip.

lines.zh: 你横在小径上，我的角过不去。
lines.en: You're across the trail; my antlers won't fit past.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，花瓣都落下来了。
lines.en: We bump, and cherry petals fall around us.

lines.zh: 别从背后贴过来，我会踢。
lines.en: Don't come up behind me; I kick.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让出半条小径。
lines.en: I turn sideways and give you half the trail.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲太硬，撞得我头发晕。
lines.en: Your armor's hard; the knock leaves me dizzy.

lines.zh: 草地这么宽，何必挤这一处。
lines.en: The meadow's wide — why squeeze through here?

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，把惊惶甩掉。
lines.en: I shake my head to throw off the fright.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰她的脖子。
lines.en: I touch her neck gently with my nose.

lines.zh: 她走在前面，我跟在两步之后。
lines.en: She walks ahead; I keep two steps behind.

lines.zh: 两只鹿角轻轻碰了一下。
lines.en: Our two sets of antlers tap together softly.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，蹄子踩得很小心。
lines.en: I circle her, setting each hoof down carefully.

lines.zh: 这片樱林够我们待一整个春天。
lines.en: This cherry grove can hold us all spring.

lines.zh: 她低头吃草，我在旁边守着。
lines.en: She grazes; I keep watch at her side.

lines.zh: 我把最嫩的那丛草让给她。
lines.en: I leave the tenderest patch of grass for her.

lines.zh: 风把她的气味带过来，我跟着走。
lines.en: The wind brings her scent, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在草地上并成一排。
lines.en: Our shadows line up side by side on the grass.

lines.zh: 等幼鹿会跑了，我们再走远些。
lines.en: Once the fawn can run, we'll wander farther.

lines.zh: 地上有枚亮东西，我用鼻子拱了拱。
lines.en: Something bright on the ground; I nudge it with my nose.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只吃草。
lines.en: I don't pick things up; I only eat grass.

lines.zh: 那朵蘑菇颜色太艳，我不碰。
lines.en: That mushroom's too bright; I leave it alone.

lines.zh: 有颗橡果滚到蹄边，我绕开了。
lines.en: An acorn rolls to my hoof; I step around it.

lines.zh: 我把落下的苹果顶回树根旁。
lines.en: I push the fallen apple back toward the roots.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，自己来拿。
lines.en: You dropped something; come get it yourself.

lines.zh: 这枚铁片凉，碰一下就走。
lines.en: This iron shard is cold; one touch and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起一根树枝，又放下。
lines.en: I lift a twig in my mouth, then drop it.

lines.zh: 花瓣堆里有东西在反光。
lines.en: Something glints inside the drift of petals.

lines.zh: 那不是食物，我闻两下就明白。
lines.en: That's not food — two sniffs tell me so.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，我先看住它。
lines.en: Something's moving over there; I'll keep my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 那只狼的尾巴低着，不是好兆头。
lines.en: That wolf's tail is low — a bad sign.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，你就是刚才那个。
lines.en: I know you now; you're the one from before.

lines.zh: 灌木后面有脚步，我耳朵先动。
lines.en: Footsteps behind the bush; my ears move first.

lines.zh: 我盯住那团影子，腿已经绷紧。
lines.en: I fix on that shape, legs already tense.

lines.zh: 这气味不对，我得记着这个方向。
lines.en: That smell is wrong; I'll remember this direction.

lines.zh: 幼鹿在我身后，我先看着前面。
lines.en: The fawn's behind me, so I watch what's ahead.

lines.zh: 那个弓箭手藏在树后，我看见了。
lines.en: That archer hides behind a tree; I saw him.

lines.zh: 我要跑的时候，会先跺一下蹄子。
lines.en: When I run, I'll stamp a hoof first.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西举起来了，我记下了。
lines.en: You raised what's in your hand; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，始终隔着一段。
lines.en: I circle you, always keeping some distance.

lines.zh: 鼻子喷气，那是我在警告。
lines.en: A snort through my nose — that's my warning.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就往右挪半步。
lines.en: You go left; I shift half a step right.

lines.zh: 别追，我跑起来你追不上。
lines.en: Don't chase me — you won't catch my run.

lines.zh: 我前蹄刨地，刨出一个小坑。
lines.en: My forehoof paws the dirt into a small pit.

lines.zh: 目光不离开你，脚步慢慢退。
lines.en: Eyes fixed on you, I retreat step by step.

lines.zh: 我低了一下头，鹿角朝前。
lines.en: I dip my head, antlers angled forward.

lines.zh: 这片林子我熟，你未必。
lines.en: I know these woods; you likely don't.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停；你动，我就退。
lines.en: You stop, I stop; you move, I back away.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就钻进树丛里。
lines.en: One more step and I'm into the thicket.

lines.zh: 前蹄抬起来，往下一蹬。
lines.en: My forelegs rear up, then stamp down.

lines.zh: 鹿角只是擦过你的肩。
lines.en: My antler only grazes across your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我顶了一下，然后立刻退开。
lines.en: I butt once, then immediately back away.

lines.zh: 后腿发力，这一踢很结实。
lines.en: Hind legs drive it — a solid kick.

lines.zh: 我不是要杀你，只想你走开。
lines.en: I'm not trying to kill you, just to make you leave.

lines.zh: 蹄子落在你的护腿上，闷响一声。
lines.en: My hoof lands on your greave with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我转半圈，用后蹄扫过去。
lines.en: I spin half around and sweep with a hind hoof.

lines.zh: 鹿角先顶，蹄子后到，你选一个。
lines.en: Antlers first, hooves after — pick one.

lines.zh: 我的头低得很低，角尖朝上挑。
lines.en: Head low, I tip my antler points upward.

lines.zh: 打完我就跑，不留下。
lines.en: Once it's done I run and don't linger.

lines.zh: 我从樱花树影里走出来。
lines.en: I step out from the shade of a cherry tree.

lines.zh: 睁眼时，脚下是厚厚的落叶。
lines.en: I open my eyes on a deep bed of leaves.

lines.zh: 鹿角上还带着出生时的湿气。
lines.en: My antlers still carry the damp of being new.

lines.zh: 这片林子安静，适合落脚。
lines.en: These woods are quiet — a good place to begin.

lines.zh: 我撑起四条腿，苔藓在蹄下陷。
lines.en: I push up on four legs; the moss gives way.

lines.zh: 远处有溪水声，我先记住方向。
lines.en: Water sounds far off; I note which way.

lines.zh: 一抬头，满树的花都在晃。
lines.en: I look up and the whole canopy sways with blossoms.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是蕨类的卷叶。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a curled fern frond.

lines.zh: 母鹿在不远处，我叫了一声。
lines.en: The doe stands nearby; I call out once.

lines.zh: 森林给了我八点生命，够用了。
lines.en: Eight points of life from the forest — enough.

lines.zh: 蹄子第一次踩在苔藓上，很软。
lines.en: My hooves touch moss for the first time — soft.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，把花瓣抖落。
lines.en: I shake my coat and the petals fall away.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，焦味很冲。
lines.en: Flame singes my coat; the scorched smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 从坡上摔下来，蹄子先着地。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and land on my hooves.

lines.zh: 水淹到脖子，我拼命划。
lines.en: Water's at my neck; I kick with all four legs.

lines.zh: 那声巨响把我掀翻在林子里。
lines.en: The blast throws me over in the woods.

lines.zh: 箭扎进后腿，我瘸了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my hind leg; I limp.

lines.zh: 紫色的光缠住我，腿不听使唤。
lines.en: Violet light wraps me; my legs won't obey.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，草也嚼不动。
lines.en: My belly's empty and I can't chew the grass.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边的树上，我耳朵嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree beside me; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，四蹄都在乱蹬。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; all four hooves thrash.
